name: odoo-json2
description: MCP tools for Odoo 19 External JSON-2 (POST /json/2/{model}/{method}). Multi-instance Dev/Test/Prod.

ODOO_URL.title: Odoo URL
ODOO_URL.description: Host or origin, e.g. mycompany.odoo.com or https://mycompany.odoo.com. https:// is added if omitted. No path.

ODOO_API_KEY.title: Odoo API key
ODOO_API_KEY.description: User API key from Preferences → Account Security → New API Key.

ODOO_DATABASE.title: Odoo database
ODOO_DATABASE.description: Single-instance database name. Ignored when named Dev/Test/Prod vars are set.

ODOO_ENVIRONMENTS.title: Odoo environments
ODOO_ENVIRONMENTS.description: Optional comma list that sets picker order, e.g. dev,test,prod. Prod is never the implicit default.

ODOO_DEV_URL.title: Dev Odoo URL
ODOO_DEV_URL.description: Dev origin, e.g. https://ipp-dev.odoo.com. Use with ODOO_DEV_API_KEY and ODOO_DEV_DATABASE.
